To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for admin meeting

Renee,

Here’s the football rundown for the noon meeting.

We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday night and locked up second place in the region. Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and two touchdowns, including a long one in the third quarter. Our line pushed them five yards back on that whole drive. Best I’ve seen those boys block all year.

Deshawn Pettaway had three sacks and seven tackles, and the defense held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half. The kids voted Deshawn defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met.

Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows we have a HOME playoff game. We host Clanton Valley in the first round Friday, November 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. We’d love to have folks come out and support the boys. Presale tickets start Tuesday. We still need to confirm the gate and chain crews by Wednesday, and the boosters need six more people for concessions.

On academics, all 52 kids on the roster are eligible after the nine-week grade check. Tonya deserves the credit there, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is the reason those grades are clean, and she’s keeping it going through the playoffs.

The Boston butt sale brought in $6,240 on 208 sold, well over the $4,500 goal. That money is going toward new sideline headsets. Carla and the boosters did a great job, and Hargrove’s Meat Market smoked them at cost.

If we win and have to go on the road, I’ll get the bus stuff to you. I know transportation needs those requests five days out.

Thanks,
Coach Tillman
